text: Where does the buyer type their card number: on the shop's site, or on the bank's?
prefix: Where does the buyer type their card number: on the shop's site, or on the bank's?

text: If shops collected card numbers, every shop would need PCI DSS, and one shop's breach would leak cards.
prefix: If shops collected card numbers, every shop would need PCI DSS, and one shop's breach would leak cards.

text: So the merchant sends the buyer to the bank's own payment page, through the one-time link it got when it created the payment.
prefix: So the merchant sends the buyer to the bank's own payment page, through the one-time link it got when it created the payment.

text: The link's token is the only credential: the database keeps only its hash, and after the configured time the link works no more.
prefix: The link's token is the only credential: the database keeps only its hash, and after the configured time the link works no more.

text: Reading the page shows the website, the amount and the order, and opens a card-entry session in card-vault, the cards unit's own service.
prefix: Reading the page shows the website, the amount and the order, and opens a card-entry session in card-vault, the cards unit's own service.

text: The session lists only the schemes the website accepts that have a live e POS terminal right now, speaks the buyer's language, and carries the sales point as its risk reference.
prefix: The session lists only the schemes the website accepts that have a live e POS terminal right now, speaks the buyer's language, and carries the sales point as its risk reference.

text: The buyer types the card and the code into card-vault's frame inside the page, so ecom never sees a card number.
prefix: The buyer types the card and the code into card-vault's frame inside the page, so ecom never sees a card number.

text: The frame answers to one parent page only, through frame-ancestors, and its content security policy and subresource integrity let nothing run but its own two files.
prefix: The frame answers to one parent page only, through frame-ancestors, and its content security policy and subresource integrity let nothing run but its own two files.

text: Those two files are the whole script inventory that PCI DSS asks for, and every load the browser blocks is reported back and logged.
prefix: Those two files are the whole script inventory that PCI DSS asks for, and every load the browser blocks is reported back and logged.

text: A card of a scheme the website doesn't accept is refused before any code is sent.
prefix: A card of a scheme the website doesn't accept is refused before any code is sent.

text: When the code is right, the frame posts the card token, the masked number, the expiry, the scheme and the issuing bank to the page, and nothing more.
prefix: When the code is right, the frame posts the card token, the masked number, the expiry, the scheme and the issuing bank to the page, and nothing more.

text: That token travels through the buyer's browser, so ecom asks card-vault whether this payment's session is bound with that same token.
prefix: That token travels through the buyer's browser, so ecom asks card-vault whether this payment's session is bound with that same token.

text: Only then the payment keeps the card, by token, mask, scheme and bank, and the debit starts in the same call.
prefix: Only then the payment keeps the card, by token, mask, scheme and bank, and the debit starts in the same call.

text: Attempts belong to the session, and how many cards and codes one session allows is the caller's configured setting.
prefix: Attempts belong to the session, and how many cards and codes one session allows is the caller's configured setting.

text: Each attempt is claimed by one atomic update before the scheme is asked, so parallel posts can't pass the limit, and a refused card still counts.
prefix: Each attempt is claimed by one atomic update before the scheme is asked, so parallel posts can't pass the limit, and a refused card still counts.

text: The last refusal ends the session, the frame tells the page so, and the page opens a fresh session, up to the configured number; past it, the payment fails.
prefix: The last refusal ends the session, the frame tells the page so, and the page opens a fresh session, up to the configured number; past it, the payment fails.

text: Card-vault also holds fraud limits against card testing: refused cards and codes are counted per card, per BIN, per payer address and per risk reference.
prefix: Card-vault also holds fraud limits against card testing: refused cards and codes are counted per card, per BIN, per payer address and per risk reference.

text: Past a limit, a new card, code or session is refused before any scheme is asked, and the page says card entry is limited for now.
prefix: Past a limit, a new card, code or session is refused before any scheme is asked, and the page says card entry is limited for now.

text: One step runs at a time: a second click while the first is still running is refused by a lock in Redis, which only its holder releases.
prefix: One step runs at a time: a second click while the first is still running is refused by a lock in Redis, which only its holder releases.

text: Next, the moment the money actually moves: the debit.
prefix: Next, the moment the money actually moves: the debit.
